caption: Two toy train cars with magnetic couplers are pushed together, and they snap together and roll as one.

sa.check: Two toy train cars on a track or floor, apart.
The joined cars roll as one.
The couplers meet end to end.
The order is push, snap, roll together.

pc.expect: Over the last small gap the couplers pull together and the cars stay joined; when one is moved the other follows without a gap opening.
pc.fail: The cars stop with a gap between the couplers and stay that way; or the couplers touch and drift apart; or one car is moved and the other stays behind; or the cars part while rolling with nothing pulling them.

pc.expect: The cars move only when pushed or pulled along; once joined they stop together and stay still.
pc.fail: A car sets off by itself before it is pushed; or the joined pair keeps rolling and stops and starts on its own; or a car slides sideways off the line; or the cars spring apart.

pc.expect: The cars roll on their wheels along the track or floor in one line, the following car tracking the leading one.
pc.fail: The cars lift off the track; or the second car swings out and rolls beside the first while joined; or a car reverses while the other goes on; or the wheels stay still while the cars slide.

pc.expect: The cars are rigid toys that keep their shape as they meet; the couplers stay small hard fittings.
pc.fail: A car squashes or bends at the meeting; or the couplers stretch like rubber; or the cars flex as they roll.

pc.expect: Two cars throughout, joined but separate; nothing merges, vanishes or passes through anything.
pc.fail: The two cars merge into one long car; or a third car appears; or a car vanishes; or one car passes through the other.

pc.expect: The cars' colours and markings and the track stay the same.
pc.fail: A car changes colour; or its markings change; or the track changes route.
